questions.question:
A: What day is today?
B: It's ______. It's the first day of school this week!
questions.explanation: 每週上課的第一天通常是星期一 (Monday)。
questions.commonMisconception: 將第一天上學日與週日混淆。

questions.question: Today is ______. Tomorrow is Sunday. We don't have school!
questions.explanation: 如果明天是週日且不用上學，那今天就是週六 (Saturday)。
questions.commonMisconception: 星期的先後順序判定錯誤。

questions.question: My favorite day is ______. It is the day before Thursday.

______ day is today?
It's Tuesday.
questions.explanation: 詢問「今天是星期幾」的固定句型為 'What day is today?'。
questions.commonMisconception: 誤用 When (問日期或具體時間點)。

questions.question:
A: Is today Friday?
B: ______, it's Friday.
questions.explanation: 對於 'Is today...?' 的肯定簡答，最正式且正確的結構是 'Yes, it is'。
questions.commonMisconception: 誤以為可以用縮寫 Yes, it's 作為句子結尾。

questions.question:
A: Is it Monday today?
B: No, ______. It's Sunday.
questions.explanation: 否定語境下，對於 'Is it...?' 的答覆應為 'No, it isn't'。

questions.question: Today is Wednesday. ______ is Thursday.
questions.explanation: 今天週三，明天 (Tomorrow) 是週四。
questions.commonMisconception: Today / Tomorrow / Yesterday 詞義混淆。

questions.question: Which sentence is CORRECT?
options: We have art class on Monday.
questions.explanation: 英文中的星期名稱第一個字母必須「大寫」。

questions.question: We have English class ______ Friday.
questions.explanation: 在「星期幾」，介係詞應使用 'on'。

questions.question:
We have PE class on Tuesday. We have music class on Friday. 
Question: What day do we have music class?
questions.explanation: 文中敘述 'We have music class on Friday'。

questions.question:
Today is Tuesday. My birthday party is in two days (兩天後).
Question: What day is the party?
questions.explanation: 週二的兩天後 (週三、週四) 是週四 (Thursday)。

questions.question:
Dad says, 'We can't go to the park on Monday to Friday. We can only go on the weekend.' 
Question: When will they go to the park?
questions.explanation: 週末 (weekend) 指的是週六和週日。選項中只有週六符合。
questions.commonMisconception: 不了解 weekend 的具體範圍。

questions.question:
Today is Friday. I will go home tomorrow. I will stay home for two days (Saturday and Sunday). Then I go to school.
Question: What day does school start?
questions.explanation: 週五後天回家，在家待週六、週日，接著週一 (Monday) 上學。
questions.commonMisconception: 邏輯鏈條過長導致推算錯誤。

questions.question:
I play soccer every Monday and Wednesday. Toby plays soccer every Tuesday and Thursday.
Question: Do they play soccer on the same day?
questions.explanation: 兩人打球的日期完全沒有重疊。

questions.question: We go to the park on ______. We go there every week.
questions.explanation: 表達「每個星期幾」，可以使用 'on Sundays' (複數名詞) 或 'every Sunday'。
questions.commonMisconception: 不知星期名稱可加 s 表達頻率概念。

questions.question: The month (月份) starts on Monday. What day is the third (第3) day?
questions.explanation: 1號是週一，2號是週二，3號是週三 (Wednesday)。

questions.question: It will rain on Saturday. It will be sun on Sunday. We should go camping on ______.
questions.explanation: 露營應選晴天，所以是週日 (Sunday)。

questions.question: In many cultures, ______ is the first day of the week, but in schools, Monday is the first day.
questions.explanation: 在西方宗教文化或許多曆法中，週日 (Sunday) 被視為一週的第一天。
questions.commonMisconception: 不了解中西曆法文化差異。
